description: The bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large when optimizations are applied to the model, comparing the performance of the NESAC ft model and the SESHA ft model. The horizontal axis represents the optimizations applied, while the vertical axis indicates the difference in average WER from Whisper large, measured in decimal values. The chart includes five optimizations: Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. For each optimization, two bars are presented side by side, one for each model, with the NESAC ft model represented in orange and the SESHA ft model in green. The values on the bars indicate the WER difference, with the NESAC ft model generally showing a lower WER difference, suggesting better performance, except for the Dates optimization where the SESHA ft model has a slightly lower WER difference. The chart does not include any sorting or emphasis on specific bars, and the values are presented in a linear scale.
